notes: Page title: 'The Energetic Sandwiches', plus 'GG Specials' section. Branded with 'kaloreez' logo top-right (green circular leaf/food logo; tagline too small to read). Light sage-green background with faint gear pattern; heading in dark brown decorative calligraphic serif; item names bold dark maroon serif; descriptions small dark sans-serif; prices maroon with '/-'. Each item has a nutrition table (kCal, Fat (g), Carb(g), Protein(g)) in white boxes with maroon borders - captured in 'nutrition' field. Green/red circular veg/non-veg markers to the left of items; Protein Sandwich, Double Decker and GG Specials have no marker. Intro: 'Life is like sandwich, we fill your sandwiches with fresh n Healthy ingredients (All the sandwiches are smeared with low fat mayo and nutralite butter)'. Double Decker description continues in bold maroon: 'Choose 2 Fillings from the below Mexican/ Spinach & Corn / Rajma / Legume / Egg / Chicken)'. Bottom photo: grilled brown-bread sandwich with chips and green capsicums. No tax/charges text. Fully legible.
